epics.title: Stagnant Task Resolution
epics.jtbd: When tasks are identified as stuck or blocked, I want the system to correctly handle and unblock them, so that the project delivery pipeline remains fluid.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of artificially stalled review tasks by 100%
requirements: R1: Patch the existing task processing logic to prevent review tasks from stagnating in the STUCK/BLOCKED TASK CANDIDATES list.

slices.title: Patch review task stagnation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the stagnation fix for this epic, I want to update the condition evaluating stuck tasks, so that review tasks flow through the pipeline instead of stalling.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a set of review tasks currently flagged as STUCK/BLOCKED
When the modified evaluation logic runs
Then the tasks are appropriately escalated or unblocked rather than stagnating indefinitely
Given normal pipeline operation
When new review tasks are created
Then they are not incorrectly categorized as stuck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease false-positive stuck task flags to 0
